sql: select c.name as buffet, c.logo_url, p.full_name, p.email, p.avatar_url is not null as tem_foto, uc.role from companies c join user_companies uc on uc.company_id = c.id join profiles p on p.user_id = uc.user_id where c.is_active and (lower(p.full_name) = lower(c.name) or uc.role = 'owner') order by c.name
